questions.question: A patient diagnosed with acute lymphoblastic leukemia undergoes pre-treatment pharmacogenomic screening and is identified as homozygous for non-functional alleles of the thiopurine S-methyltransferase gene (TPMT*3A/*3A). What is the recommended adjustment to standard 6-mercaptopurine dosing for this patient to prevent life-threatening hematologic toxicity?
options: Substantially reduce the dosage to 10% or less of the standard dose, or select an alternative drug
Increase the dosage by 50% to compensate for rapid drug inactivation and clearance
Maintain standard dosing while co-administering allopurinol to stabilize drug metabolites
Switch to an intravenous continuous infusion at standard total daily dosage

questions.question: A female carrier of a balanced Robertsonian translocation involving both copies of chromosome 21—der(21;21)(q10;q10)—becomes pregnant. What is the theoretical probability that a live-born child from this pregnancy will have Down syndrome?

A 17-year-old phenotypic male presents with delayed puberty and primary testicular failure. Karyotype analysis demonstrates a 46,XX constitution, and FISH analysis shows the presence of the SRY gene on the short arm of one X chromosome. Aberrant recombination during which process in the patient's father most likely caused this condition?
options: Mitotic replication in spermatogonial stem cells
Meiosis I crossing-over outside the pseudoautosomal region
Meiosis II non-disjunction of sister chromatids
Post-zygotic mitotic cleavage during early embryonic development

questions.question: A family presents with autosomal dominant dyskeratosis congenita caused by a heterozygous mutation in the TERC gene, which encodes the RNA component of telomerase. Over three successive generations, affected family members exhibit progressively earlier ages of onset and increasingly severe clinical manifestations. What molecular mechanism best explains this pattern of anticipation?
options: Intergenerational expansion of dynamic trinucleotide repeat sequences within the coding region
Progressive hypermethylation of CpG islands within the TERC promoter region across generations
Inheritance of progressively shorter baseline telomere lengths from affected parents to offspring
Accumulation of somatic mosaic mutations due to impaired DNA double-strand break repair

questions.question: In a quantitative genetics study examining systolic blood pressure in a population, monozygotic (MZ) twins reared together show a phenotypic correlation coefficient of 0.70, whereas dizygotic (DZ) twins reared together show a correlation coefficient of 0.35. Using Falconer's formula ($h^2 = 2(r_{MZ} - r_{DZ})$), what is the estimated narrow-sense heritability ($h^2$) of systolic blood pressure in this population?
